authorization: derive account only from verified authentication
reauthorize enabled app membership, original operation ownership and current resource binding on every read
authorization failures never enumerate or return another account's operation, source or grant

catalog.requiredFixture: test.coin definition version and visible can_grant app binding are pinned by trusted seed/import configuration
catalog.failure: unknown, retired, invisible, unbound or non-grantable resources fail closed before completion commit
catalog.exclusion: clients never select a resource, definition version, reward plan, quantity or permission

completion.receiptCorrection: schemaVersion 2 requires outcomeAuthority=client_trusted_unvalidated on every completion_recorded response
completion.meaning: authenticated client report accepted without game, session, replay, solution or outcome validation; never describe it as server validated or secure
completion.unknown: unknown authority, status, schema version or field fails closed

progression.meaning: the G3 fixture uses server-owned semantic state keys and checked nonnegative signed64 values; completion history and source uniqueness stay server-side
progression.absence: an absent progression entity is absent state, not an inferred completion; explicit null is not permitted

value.meaning: test.coin confirmed balance is a checked nonnegative signed64 decimal string in diagnostic JSON and C# long/TS bigint in runtime mappings
value.absence: an absent wallet entity is not a confirmed zero balance; explicit null is not permitted
value.receipt: historical reward quantity never mutates a client balance directly; ordered bootstrap/pull owns confirmed value

reward.shape: reuse the approved live-slice receipt and typed lines
reward.absenceAndNull: reward is required for completion_recorded; explicit null means committed with no server grant; omission is invalid; not_found carries neither reward nor outcomeAuthority
reward.operationIdempotency: operationId identifies the looked-up immutable accepted command and originatingOperationId identifies the first operation that committed the grant
reward.sourceIdempotency: backend/app/account plus source kind/key/rewardSlot selects at most one grant; retries or another operation for that source reuse the same immutable grant
reward.signed64: feedRevision and quantities are checked signed64, decimal strings only in diagnostic JSON

visibility.wireShape: reuse the single private-player visibilityGeneration already carried by bootstrap and cursor semantics
visibility.catalogGeneration: BE-017 app catalog generation is an authorization input, not a second client-visible generation
visibility.requiredBridge: before bootstrap or pull authorization, compare the app catalog generation with the player's last observed catalog generation; a mismatch advances the existing private-player visibility generation and requires a replacement snapshot before old shared state can be revealed
visibility.revokeRegrant: both revoke and regrant advance catalog generation; neither may reveal retained shared state through an old cursor
visibility.runtimeState: the cross-owner persistence bridge and transaction tests remain BE-012/BE-013/BE-017 implementation work

compatibility.frozenCore: all 90 version 0.2.0 core artifacts remain unchanged
compatibility.g2Receipt: all four version 0.3.0 live-slice artifacts remain unchanged; capability v1 stays a distinct schema
compatibility.rollout: v2 requires explicit trusted capability composition; missing capability, 404 or 501 is unavailable
